categories.main_business_segments: SAMCO INC. operates a single business segment focused on the manufacturing and sales of semiconductor and electronic component production equipment. Its main product categories are thin film deposition (CVD and ALD equipment), dry etching equipment, dry cleaning equipment, and related parts and maintenance services. The company serves both research and production applications across various device types.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies center on thin film deposition (notably CVD and ALD), dry etching using high-density plasma (Tornado ICP), and advanced dry cleaning methods such as plasma and UV-ozone cleaning. SAMCO emphasizes proprietary process innovations, such as LS-CVD using liquid precursors for safer, low-temperature, uniform film formation, and Aqua Plasma cleaning for environmentally friendly surface treatment. Manufacturing is based on in-house design with outsourced production to partner firms, followed by in-house software integration and quality inspection.
categories.primary_customers_markets: SAMCO's key customers are manufacturers and research institutions in the compound semiconductor, silicon semiconductor, electronic components (MEMS, sensors, filters), and healthcare device fields. Its equipment is used for processing LEDs, power devices, high-frequency devices, silicon photonics, MEMS, and microfluidic devices, as well as by universities and public research labs.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally, with a strong presence in Japan, Taiwan, China, South Korea, North America, and growing activities in Europe, Southeast Asia, and India. Domestic sales accounted for 61.6% and overseas sales for 38.4% in FY2025, with a strategic goal to raise overseas sales to over 50%. SAMCO maintains local offices and subsidiaries for sales and service in key international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: SAMCO is positioned as an equipment supplier (midstream) in the semiconductor and electronics manufacturing supply chain. It provides essential production tools to device manufacturers and research institutions, enabling upstream material processing and downstream device fabrication.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing new processes and equipment to meet emerging customer needs, expanding sales for production-use equipment, and strengthening after-sales service. The company is investing in R&D for advanced thin film and etching technologies, with a focus on applications in life sciences and energy. Sustainability, energy efficiency, and global market expansion are also emphasized, alongside talent development and diversity initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: SAMCO generates revenue primarily through the sale of capital equipment (CVD, ALD, etching, and cleaning systems), as well as parts and maintenance services. Revenue is recognized upon delivery, installation, and acceptance of equipment, with additional recurring income from after-sales support and spare parts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: SAMCO competes with global and domestic manufacturers of semiconductor production equipment, particularly in the niche of thin film deposition and dry etching for compound semiconductors and MEMS. The company differentiates itself through proprietary technologies and a strong focus on R&D and customer-driven innovation, maintaining a specialized position rather than competing directly with the largest generalist equipment makers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In FY2025, SAMCO reported sales of 9.34 billion yen, operating profit of 2.34 billion yen, and net profit of 1.70 billion yen, with a workforce of 191 employees. The company has demonstrated steady growth, with sales increasing by 13.9% and net profit by 15.3% year-on-year. The balance sheet is robust, with a high equity ratio (76.3%) and strong cash reserves.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: SAMCO emphasizes unique, proprietary thin film and plasma technologies that enable high-precision, safe, and environmentally friendly processing for advanced semiconductor and electronic devices. Its value proposition includes customized solutions for both R&D and production, rapid response to customer needs, and a strong after-sales support network. The company positions itself as a technology innovator with a focus on quality, safety, and sustainability.
